items.title: Critical FortiWeb WAF Flaw Exploited in the Wild, Enabling Full Admin Takeover
items.description: Fortinet has issued an urgent advisory warning of a critical vulnerability in its FortiWeb web application firewall (WAF) product, which attackers are actively exploiting in the wild. Identified as CVE-2025-64446, the flaw stems from improper access control in the GUI component, allowing unauthenticated threat actors to execute administrative commands and potentially seize complete control of…
